crossRefs.note: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
“In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.
Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

parallels.note: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

translations.web: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
translations.bsb: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
translations.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
translations.asv: Even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh.
